question: Implement linear regression on the provided dataset and evaluate its performance using two distinct methods: leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) and a single 80-20 train-test split. Compare the resulting error metrics from both evaluation approaches.

expected_output.guidelines: LOOCV metrics must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error; train-test split metrics need only show positive R2 and self-consistent MSE, RMSE, and MAE; column order and header labels may differ.
